before.title: Cover positive Boolean programs through public Core checking
before.body:
Add two positive source programs that exercise Boolean precedence, comparisons, postconditions and a Core/2 Await guard through the actual public Rust checker. Compare each complete 21-node Program and both JSON and human checker streams against hand-derived frozen files. Document the named finite-fixture convention in RUST_GUIDELINES.md.

Validation: one aggregate Rust test passed at 27b3b12c; all four public checker processes exited 0 and matched their complete expected streams, and both complete API Program values matched the frozen expectations. All 911 recorded source pins match that tested commit. The later 1f3c927d change adds seven guideline lines only; the eight tested bodies and all production/build inputs remain identical. No new subject run is claimed for that documentation change.

The earlier review opinion is preserved with a one-line citation correction and a guideline-scope finding. The named exception addresses that finding; a fresh full source/result review of the final nine-path candidate is pending. No production change or RED defect is claimed. Expectations disclose implementation-source exposure. These static checks establish no runtime predicate truth, independent financial oracle, compiler Artifact, proof, ledger acceptance or closure of the 27-constructor scope.

Draft stacked on #249.

actualReplacement.title: Cover Boolean source checks without the financial stack
actualReplacement.body:
Adds two positive Boolean source specimens through the real public Core1/Core2 checker and complete Program comparisons. This is the independent main delivery of the eight fixture/test files from PR250, plus only their seven-line guideline convention.

Validation: one selected Rust test passed on the header integration base; four real CLI processes exited 0 with complete frozen output matches, and both complete 21-node Programs matched. All886 source pins bind the tested working tree to `ce7d16557fc0605f929357628d907d2a66d6153c`. The pre-execution expectations remain unchanged and explicitly disclose implementation-source exposure.

Fresh whole nine-file source/result review is pending. Static admission and serialization only: no action execution, independent financial/work oracle, compiler Artifact, proof or ledger acceptance. All27 constructor obligations remain open.

Based on PR252 to avoid pulling the pending financial/help/docs stack. After PR252 merges, retarget to main. PR250 can be closed as superseded only after this delivery actually merges; its original history and qualified review remain preserved.


Current complete source and actual-result review is qualified and adopted for exact `ce7d16557fc0605f929357628d907d2a66d6153c` / tree `77bf20aa4556293f1399f10c6a5deefa0697c819`. Whole opinion SHA256 `8f5d74f996214b42ef60f49d1fd1c296e2a69a96d3ace9b4a2d47bf83b3fc31c`; root adoption `9806b544b47ad3e9f6e2ed3be36473f9ea6c34796c995a65494fee69cc8bf087`. Exact nine paths, 93 bodies, 56 source units and 886 Git/worktree pins were compared. Actual one-test pass, four complete public CLI captures and both complete Program results remain static admission/serialization evidence with source-exposed author expectations. Two anchor starts and Program-metadata wording are separately qualified; the whole opinion remains unchanged. No runtime, proof or ledger exit closes.
